title: VQPy: An Object-Oriented Approach to Modern Video Analytics
problem: Video analytics systems struggle with modularity and composability when building complex processing pipelines. Imperative approaches lack abstraction mechanisms for reusable, optimizable video operations.
motivation: Video analytics is increasingly critical for real-time applications including autonomous systems, surveillance, and content analysis, requiring efficient programmable systems.
method: VQPy provides an object-oriented abstraction layer enabling modular composition of video processing operations. The framework uses declarative query patterns to specify analytics tasks. A compiler optimizes query execution through operation fusion, scheduling, and mapping to hardware accelerators like GPUs.
key_novelty: Object-oriented abstraction paradigm for expressing video analytics queries with emphasis on composability and automated optimization.
contributions: Object-oriented programming model for video analytics
Composable design patterns for video operations
limitations: Not discussed (analysis based on title only).
